actions.summary: With no Texas state guidance, El Paso ISD wrote its own AI policy and El Paso-area districts have adopted classroom tools such as PowerBuddy and MagicSchool AI alongside AI-literacy lessons.
actions.notes: Carried over from the TX state profile's free-text note. effective_from is the date of the El Paso Matters coverage, not a board adoption date; the specific adopting authority and date are unverified - firm up from the district's board minutes. Enrollment figure is approximate.
